comment: Setup was smooth and the activation email arrived instantly.
Month 2 value unclear. We almost cancelled.
Onboarding wizard too complex for our small team.
Digest email in spam. I never saw it.
Support was quick on GDPR questions.
First run is confusing. No guided tour.
Price is fine but seat management is opaque.
Activation metric clarity improved our funnel work.
Reports render slowly on big datasets.
Legacy CSV export broke after API v2.
Trial activation worked well this quarter.
Would like an exit survey follow-up.
SSO setup is the only blocker.
Retention improved but churn in month 2 persists.
